_original_lore: This plant loves a good challenge.
Every time you harvest it, it'll
challenge you to a quick game. Win,
and it thrives. Lose, though, and it's
game over for this little guy.
name: 植物男孩 进阶版

source: This plant loves a good challenge.
Every time you harvest it, it'll
challenge you to a quick game. Win,
and it thrives. Lose, though, and it's
game over for this little guy.
loreParagraphs.translation: 每次你收获它时,它都会挑战你玩一局快速游戏.赢了,它就会茁壮成长.但如果输了,这个小家伙就完蛋了.
完成访客 Beth 的任务来分析这种作物!
